Question: In a certain land, all Arogs are Brafs, all Crups are Brafs, all Dramps are Arogs, and all Crups are Dramps. Which of the following statements is implied by these facts?

Choices.A: All Dramps are Brafs and are Crups.
Choices.B: All Brafs are Crups and are Dramps.
Choices.C: All Arogs are Crups and are Dramps.
Choices.D: All Crups are Arogs and are Brafs.
Choices.E: All Arogs are Dramps and some Arogs may not be Crups.
